results.title: China and India in a standoff at multiple locations along Arunachal border since July, India hosted Xi Jinping from Sep 11-13 for the BRICS
results.description:
China and India in a standoff at multiple locations along Arunachal border since July, India hosted Xi Jinping from Sep 11-13 for the BRICS summit. 
“In the past few-days, a situation arose where face-off happened at several locations in Arunachal and it still continues,” ITBP D-G Shatrujeet Kapur said on Thursday.
This is the first official confirmation of the scale of the continuing tensions on the north-eastern border since July this year.
Government sources told The Hindu that since late July, India and China have been engaged in a stand-off at Asaphila near Taksing in Arunachal Pradesh. The Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) is said to have pitched tents at an elevation, within 6-7 kilometres of India’s perception of the Line of Actual Control (LAC) near Maja company operating base in Taksing circle of Upper Subansiri district, sources said. I ✍️

results.title: China doesn't need soldiers to fight the Indian army on the border; they just need a few drone operators who can operate them with precision.
results.description:
China doesn't need soldiers to fight the Indian army on the border; they just need a few drone operators who can operate them with precision. 

< Almost every second Chinese company manufactures drones. 
< They have vast drone technology and production capacity.
< They simply need to pinpoint the exact location of an military post, and they can launch an attack with thousands of drones without using infantry.
< The Chinese are using drone technology for domestic work, logistics, farming, military, and many other things.
